name: Taipei Game Show
blurb: Asia-Pacific's leading consumer-and-trade video game expo at Taipei's Nangang Exhibition Center, with a player zone, indie games, tabletop and an industry summit.

editions.evidence: Official event-info page (tgs.tca.org.tw/?p=event_info): '活動名稱：2027台北國際電玩展 ... 【APGS亞太遊戲高峰會】1/21(四)–1/22(五) 【B2B商務區】1/21(四)–1/22(五) 【B2C玩家區】1/21(四)–1/24(日) 展出地點：南港展覽餆1館 主辦单位：台北市電腦公會' (2027 Taipei Game Show: APGS summit & B2B zone Jan 21-22, B2C player zone Jan 21-24; venue Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1; organizer Taipei Computer Association). Used the full B2C player-zone span (Jan 21-24) as the edition dates since that is the public-facing run.

notes: The homepage's default visible program detail (speaker lists, exhibitor lists, floor plans under a '2026展出內容' heading) is still the 2026 edition's content, but the dedicated event-info page's header block explicitly names '2027台北國際電玩展' with the dates above, and the homepage news feed independently confirms registration for the 2027 edition is open. No individual guest/celebrity program exists — like gamescom asia, this is a trade-association-run B2B/B2C games expo (exhibitor booths, an APGS industry summit with speakers, an indie-game and tabletop zone) rather than a con with a curated guest roster, so guests is 'none'. Organizer and venue both match the given note.
